items.title: File:Downtown Grocery Store, New Orleans 1885 by Ellsworth Woodward.jpg
items.description:
Downtown Grocery Store, New Orleans 1885 watercolor by Ellsworth Woodward 

Notes: "Downtown" in context meaning the old down-river neighborhoods of the city.

Description: Watercolor painting in grey colors of streetscape with 1 and 2 story brick buildings.  It has probably recently rained, as there are puddles on the street reflecting part of the scene. Streetcar tracks run down the street. The buildings show signs of age, with some irregular weathered plaster. Building at left has a roof-covered front sidewalk, with a sign above the roof line reading "GROCERIES".  Outside the shop are several wooden barrels and a wheel-barrow. Wooden door shutters of the shop are open. 
Further right, a man walks on the sidewalk. Further right still, another man stands in front of an open doorway of another building.
items.review_notes: Painting rather than real camera ground; retained unscored diagnostic

items.title: File:A fishy puddle - geograph.org.uk - 603243.jpg
items.description:
A fishy puddle. As we splashed through this puddle we were surprised to see additional splashes around us, all the more so when we realised that they were made by a small speckled fish which had moved in from the little burn that crosses the path here. On our way back in the evening the fish was still there but as we watched it swam back into the burn above the path.
You can see the fish here 605671
items.review_notes: Visible bounded pool or small standing-water patch
